rule: Each colour-1 T marker (3-cell bar plus a stem from the bar middle) repaints the region its stem points into: the region of the cell two steps from the centre. The paint is the bar-centre colour if that is not 1, otherwise the colour of the region the T sits in. All repaints use the original marker-erased layout and the markers vanish. If a 5-cell colour-9 L marker is present, it is erased and the result is rotated: counter-clockwise for a top-right corner, clockwise for a top-left corner.
scope: Random canvases have sides 8..30 with 3..8 connected regions. Guillotine partitions are optionally deformed by boundary-patch transfers that preserve region connectivity; rectangle and irregular layouts are both supported. Adjacent regions have distinct colours. Ts point in all four directions and target distinct regions. Optional colour-9 TR/TL L markers trigger rotation. Explicit num_regions/num_markers requests are exact; default marker proposals may yield fewer, with at least two. Canonical irregular canvases are reconstructed by erasing explicit marker latents from fixture inputs; random scenes do not replay fixtures.
constraints: Every region remains 4-connected after boundary deformations.
Neighbouring regions, including diagonal neighbours, have distinct colours; colour 1 is reserved for T markers.
Every T bounding box lies inside one owner region and its two-step target lies in a different region.
Markers do not overlap; each target region is painted at most once.
An L marker, if present, has a uniform surrounding region and colour 9.
Incidental five-cell corners are excluded to avoid the archived solver's overbroad rotation heuristic.
known_limitations: Irregular scenes are deformed rectangular partitions, not arbitrary free-form region topologies.
Only TR/TL rotation markers are sampled, matching demonstrations.
Fixture reconstruction uses supplied input rows plus explicit marker latents; fresh random sampling is separate.
Default marker targets are adaptive, but explicit requested counts are exact.
The saved solver detects any-colour five-cell L components as rotation markers. Random scenes exclude incidental fragments with that shape; two counterexamples are preserved.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback
